item.title: Valwood School competes at region Science Olympiad
item.description: The Valwood Science Olympiad team traveled to the University of North Georgia in Gainesville on Saturday to compete in a regional Science Olympiad tournament.

item.title: Georgia craft beer makers back bill to allow more sales outside of breweries
item.description: Breweries are asking Georgia lawmakers to loosen restrictions on selling to retailers and on the amount individuals can buy to drink at home.

item.title: Student athletes would be freed from permanent sponsorship contracts under legislation in Georgia
item.description: Student athletes who sign sponsorship contracts in high school would not be stuck with those contract terms after graduation, under legislation approved unanimously Wednesday by the Georgia House of Representatives.
